prs.title: Gracefully terminate active sessions during StreamableHTTP shutdown
prs.author: Bortlesboat
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. Both PRs add the same fix: iterate `_sse_stream_writers` in `terminate()` and close each writer, then clear the dict; both also add a graceful pre-shutdown terminate-all-sessions loop in the manager's lifespan `finally` block. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Active SSE stream writers are not closed before session tasks are cancelled during shutdown, causing Uvicorn to log ASGI-incomplete-response errors. prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #2259 is a strict superset of #2253: it includes the same SSE-writer teardown and manager shutdown loop, plus an idempotency guard (`if self._terminated: return`) that prevents double-termination races, and its `_sse_stream_writers` loop omits the `# pragma: no cover` annotation so the branch is actually exercised by tests. PR #2253 lacks the guard and marks the loop as uncovered.
